_about: Headline wording for the news desk (ADR-082). Edit freely: no rule reads this file. {winner}, {team} and the like are nicknames and take plural verbs ("Bison rout Comets"); {winnerCity}, {teamCity} and the like are cities and take singular verbs ("Elmwood routs Ironvale"). Each story needs at least one straight and one punchy line. Avoid "a" or "an" right before a placeholder ("a 18-point", "a Atlantic North"): the right one depends on the value. A key like "SHOWDOWN.tied" is a variant the rules ask for by name. punchyShare is how often a headline is written punchy.
